points.point: Why is my Pinterest not verified?
points.sentence: Once you get 100+ views per month, then reconnect your Pinterest account with Blotato and it will be automatically verified.

points.point: Need it to post this week (can verification be sped up?)
points.sentence: There is no manual override -- the 100 monthly views threshold is the only unlock criterion.

verdict.reason: The entry explains the verification criterion (100+ monthly views, then reconnect) and states there is no manual override, which answers the "why" question; it does not confirm this customer's own view count, and the "this week" urgency has no stated consequence.
